# @eltonbautista/vue

Cabinet is a small, playful Vue 3 component library with an arcade-cabinet feel and a tested accessibility contract on every component.

**Components:** `CabButton`, `CabTextField`, `CabCheckbox`, `CabSwitch`, `CabSelect`, `CabTabs`, `CabDialog`, `CabCard`.

## Install

```sh
npm i @eltonbautista/vue @eltonbautista/tokens
```

```ts
// main.ts
import '@eltonbautista/tokens/tokens.css'   // design tokens (CSS custom properties)
import '@eltonbautista/tokens/fonts.css'    // Sora + Outfit (optional)
import '@eltonbautista/vue/style.css'       // component styles
```

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { ref } from 'vue'
import { CabButton, CabTextField } from '@eltonbautista/vue'
const email = ref('')
</script>

<template>
  <CabTextField v-model="email" label="Email" type="email" />
  <CabButton>Book a seat</CabButton>
</template>
```

## Accessibility

Every component follows a WAI-ARIA APG pattern and documents its keyboard map, focus behaviour and screen-reader output. Each one is tested in a real browser for keyboard interaction and axe violations. See the Storybook docs for each component's Accessibility section.

content.text:
The landing page is in `src/App.vue` and `npm run build` passes with no errors. I haven't opened it in a browser or run an accessibility checker, so the keyboard and screen-reader behaviour is untested.

**What's on the page**
- **Title and intro:** an `h1` and a short intro, plus a "Skip to sign-up" link for keyboard users.
- **Tracks:** Board games, Digital and Live-action are `CabCard`s linking to `/tracks/board`, `/tracks/digital` and `/tracks/larp`. The card's title is the link and its hit area covers the whole card, so a click anywhere goes to the track page. Keyboard users get one tab stop per card.
- **Sign-up form:** name, email and experience level, plus a code-of-conduct checkbox.
  - Submitting with anything missing or invalid shows an error summary and focuses it. Each field also shows its own error.
  - The checkbox has no error prop, so its error text shows in the hint slot.
  - The form uses `novalidate` so the page's own messages are used instead of the browser's.
- **Email reminders:** a `CabSwitch` that saves as soon as you toggle it, with a live status line ("Saving…", then "Saved. Email reminders are on/off.").
- **Confirmation:** a valid submit opens a `CabDialog` summarising name, email and experience. "Confirm booking" completes it, and a booked message gets focus.

**Placeholders to replace**
- The booking request and the reminder save are stand-ins (a short timer each). Replace them with real API calls.
- The code of conduct is only mentioned in the checkbox hint, with no link to a document, so add one if you have it.
